partner_result.applied_inequality: ||p_Q||_inf <= 6 e^(2/3)|det M|^(-1/3) <= 11.686404246328054/sigma on the full-null-bank boundary

new_result.statement: For an exact-rank-three indefinite frame with a null rank-one source bank of leverage lambda and a disjoint M-orthogonal tangent rank-one source bank of leverage mu, ||p_Q||_inf <= 8 lambda^(-1/4) mu^(-1/2)/sqrt(|s beta|), where s=||Mr|| and beta=v^TMv. If sigma_min(M)>=sigma and eta=dist(v,span(r)), this is <=8 lambda^(-1/4)mu^(-1/2)eta^(-1)/sigma.
new_result.mechanism: A translation-stable half-potential estimate allows arbitrary dependence among the residual spectral coordinates. The null-bank product lowers the rank-two hyperbolic singularity from |W|^-1 to |W|^-1/2 at the half-potential level; the independent tangent-square bank pays that half-potential.

next_step: From a near-unit null bank with leverage below one, force either a quantitative M-orthogonal tangent rank-one bank or a product-preserving rank-two/three residual aggregation certificate already covered by pair/ridge/grouped mechanisms; then address arbitrary additional spectrum.
